__comment: The two-layer machine-part model: a casing background (#bg_*) and the machine's own overlay (#ov_*).
Only the BACKGROUND carries tintindex 1 — that is what lets a machine definition's `color` tint the
casing while the overlay (the machine's face art) keeps its own colours. This mirrors the original's
`blockmodel_overlay.json`, whose bg_* faces carried `"tintindex": 1` and whose ov_* faces did not
The colour itself comes from the block colour handler, which reads the machine colour off the block
entity — the original pushed that value onto every colour-able part when the structure formed
